digest.component_or_area: LLM fallback model instrumentation and tracing
propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one rebar OTel child span under the Agent model-request span, zero-based ordered, with no duplication from instrument_all.
Each candidate span must carry an outcome drawn only from {returned, raised} and provider-qualified model identity as attributes.
A candidate span reason on failure must be sanitized through sanitize_diagnostic under the message key with no prompt, response, credential, or endpoint secret exposed.
The bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade must remain observable as a native attempt raised span followed by a prompted attempt returned span with no change to _pai_structured control flow.
Span emission or exporter failures while tracing is enabled must leave the fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exception identical to tracing-off.
The existing ordered FallbackExceptionGroup, UsageLimits, pricing, JSONL, and durable usage must be unchanged by candidate instrumentation and must contain no candidate request counter.
